rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an intermediate size, degree, or amount.

example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 tim4 dou6 zung1 dang2

rows.note: Use this for a labeled medium size, especially clothing or other products with size categories.

example.english: I want to buy a medium shirt.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gin6 zung1 maa5 seot1 saam1

rows.note: Use this informal description specifically when something is neither large nor small in physical size.

example.english: This table is medium in size, just right.
example.traditional: 呢張枱唔大唔細，啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi4 m4 daai6 m4 sai3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use 中碼 for a labelled medium size, especially for clothes, shoes, and manufactured items.

example.english: I’d like a medium in this shirt, please.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 jiu3 zung1 maa5 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use 中間 as the all-purpose noun for a literal middle point or degree, including a compromise.

example.english: Set the water temperature to a medium level and it’ll be just right.
example.jyutping: seoi2 wan1 gaau3 dou3 zung1 gaan1 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

rows.note: Use 渠道 for the channel or route through which communication, business, or an aim is carried out.

example.english: The company mainly uses online channels as a medium to reach customers.
example.traditional: 公司主要靠網上渠道搵客。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 mong5 soeng6 keoi4 dou6 wan2 haak3

rows.note: Use 媒介 for a communication go-between or, especially in arts writing, the material or method used for expression.

example.english: Oil paint is the main medium of this painting.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫嘅主要媒介係油彩。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 mui4 gaai3 hai6 jau4 coi2

rows.note: Use this when ordering meat cooked medium-rare, with a red centre.

example.english: I want my steak cooked medium rare.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 ngau4 paa4 saam1 sing4 suk6
